description: I'm Yasin, a React and React Native developer (TypeScript, Firebase, Expo) with experience building business dashboards, mobile apps, and API integrations. For this hackathon I'm building a Martian Map: a tablet-style web app for an astronaut's Marswalk in the Gale Crater and Mount Sharp area. It layers real NASA data (orbital imagery, terrain, thermal), draws a walking route that avoids steep ground, and shows rover photos and safety notes for each science stop.
